application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Tree Species & Numbers (as shown on sketch plan)

T1 – Mature Lime (Tilia × europaea)

Located at the rear boundary. Previously pollarded with established knuckle formation visible.

T2 – Semi-mature Lime (Tilia × europaea)

Situated adjacent to T1. Previously managed via pollarding with defined regrowth points.

T3 – Apple (Malus domestica)

Garden fruit tree showing historic pollard/reduction points with dense upper crown regrowth.


Description of Proposed Works

T1, T2, and T3:

Pollard all three trees back to their previous pollard points, removing approximately 2–4 metres of current season and secondary regrowth (final cuts to suitable growth points).

Works are proposed to:
Maintain trees at a sustainable size for the garden setting
Reduce end-weight and sail effect
Manage crown density
Minimise risk of branch failure
Promote structured regenerative growth from established pollard heads

All works will be carried out in accordance with BS3998:2010 – Tree Work Recommendation

The trees have historically been managed by pollarding and the proposed works represent cyclical maintenance rather than a change in arboricultural practice.
